items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip injury; expected to return vs Eagles.
items.why: Cleared final injury report; hip/groin resolved enough for return.
items.implication: WR1 upside returns but monitor snap limits.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets likely high if unlimited; limits could cap volume.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN; returns from hamstring.
items.why: Final report clear; good to go vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Elite WR target immediately back in lineup.
items.opportunity: High target share expected; elite DvP boost.

items.text: Breece Hall and De'Von Achane both OUT; Achane season-ending context in reports.
items.why: Thigh for Hall; ACL for Achane.
items.opportunity: Full snap shares for backups; goal-line/third-down.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ruled OUT for Sunday (ankle); part of broader OUT list including Hall, Smith, Goedert, Price, Daniels, Mayfield, Achane.
items.implication: Vikings WR1 void creates massive opportunity elsewhere.
items.opportunity: Full target vacuum for Addison et al.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) vs Rams; also Goedert and Baun out.
items.implication: Eagles pass game severely depleted vs Rams.
items.opportunity: Targets shift to remaining WRs/TE; Hurts may struggle.

items.text: Great to have Puka Nacua (hip) back; speculation he could have snaps limited, we'll see.
items.why: Return from multi-week absence; historical load management possible.
items.implication: Startable but ceiling may be capped short-term.
items.opportunity: Full role would restore elite route share; limited snaps open for Adams/others.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return. Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans 7th-most implied points.
items.why: DvP data + team total support big game on return.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets vs soft secondary; red-zone likely.

items.text: The moment Jordan Addison truthers have been waiting for. Home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.opportunity: Target share spike, routes, red-zone looks.

items.text: Eagles situation getting worse. Without three of most important players vs Rams: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun.
items.implication: Full offense downgrade; avoid Eagles skill beyond Hurts/Barkley carefully.
items.opportunity: Secondary receivers elevated but overall volume may drop.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest injury, Charbonnet back practicing. Still eye-test passes; long-term far from over. Now OUT.
items.why: Multiple role erosions + injury + competition returning.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps last week, 20 of 22 RB touches; Dowdle out; CLE allows big RB games. Top-10 play.
items.why: Workhorse role locked with teammate out + soft matchup.

items.text: LOVE Jeremiyah Love: 26 touches last week (RB5 util); Giants allow 5.1 YPC; double-digit target share every game.
items.why: Explosive usage spike + favorable YPC matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB start with receiving upside.

items.text: LOVE Drake London: 35%+ career target share with Penix, 43.5% last week (9-194); NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
HATE Omarion Hampton: low util (RB27), 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42%, only 13% third-down; SEA tough vs RBs.
items.why: Declining role + poor efficiency profile + tough matchup.
